description.zh:
实例ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeDBInstances](~~196830~~)接口查看目标地域下所有实例的详情，包括实例ID。
description.en:
The instance ID.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~196830~~) operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs.

description.zh: 分页时返回的最多数目，范围在1～100之间。
description.en: The maximum number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100.

The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of NextToken.
The region ID of the instance.
The name of the schema to which the table belongs.

description.zh:
访问凭证。通过CreateSecret接口创建。

> 通过子账号访问此接口时，需要有对此SecretArn的UseSecret或GetSecretValue的权限。
description.en:
The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the access credential for the created Data API account. You can call the CreateSecret operation to create an access credential.

>  To call the ListTables operation as a Resource Access Management (RAM) user, the RAM user must have the permissions to call the UseSecret or GetSecretValue operation on the ARN of the access credential.

description.zh: 表名称匹配模式，比如```ab%```表示以ab开头的名称。
description.en: The table name pattern for matching. For example, `ab%` specifies to match table names that start with ab.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb list-tables --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --secret-arn acs:gpdb:cn-beijing:103300:secret/testsecret-eG2AQGRIwQ0zFp4VA7mYL3uiCXTfDQbQ --database adbtest --max-results 100 --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --table-pattern ab% --schema public --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun gpdb ListTables --region cn-hangzhou --SecretArn 'acs:gpdb:cn-beijing:103300:secret/testsecret-eG2AQGRIwQ0zFp4VA7mYL3uiCXTfDQbQ' --NextToken caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --TablePattern 'ab%' --DBInstanceId 'gp-xxxxxxxxx' --MaxResults 100 --Schema public --Database adbtest --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
